title: Loose Horse
description:
A horse has escaped from the horseplace and is running in a frenzy. Prey is scared away, and a twoleg might appear soon to catch it.
Roll an 8 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to avoid its hooves!

title: Falling Tree
description:
Due to wind, weather, or age, a tree is collapsing.
Roll an 8 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to avoid it!
*Note: If this is WindClan camp, disregard and try again.*

title: Fox Attack
description: A familiar smell reaches you on the wind, but by the time you recognize it, a fox charges out of a bush!

title: Badger Attack
description: A large, black and white creature lumbers through the brush on large paws. You quickly recognize it as a badger!

title: Snake Attack
description: A strange hissing sounds alerts you to the presence of a snake, and it sounds angry!

title: Mink Attack
description: A long, dark black creature slides out of the water. The mink's dark beedy eyes lock onto you, ready to lunge.

title: Hawk Attack
description: A large hawk circles above, watching your movements closely. On the next circle, it dives down, talons outstretched.

title: Cat Trap
description:
Something smells really good, better even than fresh prey. One problem: it's inside of a box with silver bars. It seems safe, though. Will you try to get it out?
Roll a 15 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to successfully get the food out!

title: Monster
description:
As you approach the Thunderpath, it suddenly starts rumbling.
Roll a 6 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to get out of its way.

title: Hooked Fish
description: A fish that you've caught has a sharp, shiny attachment in its mouth and a strong piece of cobweb that seems to have snapped. Be careful handling and eating!

title: Tripping Over Yourself
description:
You see a big, juicy piece of prey ahead and quickly stalk it. But you're too focused on how hungry you are and your attempt to catch it is thwarted by a hole or a rock that you trip on.
Roll an 8 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to avoid a sprain.

title: Tripping Over Yourself
description: You see a tempting feather up ahead and quickly stalk it. But you're too focused on how exciting this is and your attempt to catch it is thwarted by a stick you trip on. Hopefully no one saw that!

title: Fuzz in Mouse Clothing
description: What you thought was a nice, big mouse turns out to be a clump of someone's fur.

title: Fish Are Rude
description: You get low to the water in preparation to snag a fish as it swims by, but instead one jumps out of the water and smacks you in the face before quickly swimming away.

title: Poisoned Prey
description: This prey ate something that it shouldn't have. Be careful if you choose to eat it!

title: Snatched
description: A small mouse nibbles at some food nearby, focused entirely on what its doing and unaware of your approach. Seconds before you prepare to make your pounce, a large hawk swoops down and snatches it off the ground.

title: That's Not a Rabbit
description: You run at a rabbit, but instead of running, it turns to face you. It turns out the rabbit is a hare, and its angry.

title: Shallow Pool
description:
Some brown trout have gotten stuck in a small pool of water and have nowhere to hide!
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch.

title: Rabbit Burrow
description:
You come upon a small burrow of baby rabbits, and the mother is away.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Salmon Run
description:
A bunch of salmon are tired from swimming upriver.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Frog Went a-Courting
description:
Frogs carelessly sing loudly, unaware of the danger of your presence.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: It's Raining Leaves
description:
A flurry of leaves fall from the sky.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Unexpected Visitor
description:
A couple dragonflies are hanging out nearby, seemingly unaware of your presence.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Mouse Nest
description:
You find a small nest filled with mice.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Lizard Scramble
description:
You find a bunch of lizards sunning themselves on a rock.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: A Feast
description:
The Twolegs left kittypet food out for the loners in the area.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how much you find!

title: Fallen Nest
description:
A finch nest fell out of a tree nearby.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many birds you find!

title: Rapid Currents
description:
The water is moving quickly and a couple sunear have accidentally jumped out.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Gust of Wind
description:
A strong gust of wind knocked some young chickadees down.
Use `!roll 1d4` to see how many you catch!

title: Easy Catch
description: A fat squirrel falls out of a tree right in front of you and is too stunned to realize you're there.

title: Bombs Away
description: A bird soars overhead and lets loose droppings that hit you on the head.

title: Angry Squirrels
description: An angry squirrel throws sticks and stones at you as you walk through the forest, alerting all other prey of your presence. Hopefully you didn't intend on hunting!

title: Tree Fort
description: Some twoleg kits are playing nearby, moving and bending twigs and branches to create a strange structure that stays up after they leave.

title: Sheep Herding
description: The twolegs are moving the sheep to new grazing areas! There's a couple dogs barking and guiding them, but they seem focused on their work.

title: Colorful Skies
description: The twolegs seem to be running around holding strong cobweb attached to brightly-colored shapes that fly above in the sky.

title: Whosits and Whatsits Galore
description: You find a strange object on the ground. It's silvery and reflects the sky in a rounded shape attached to a longer piece. It smells vaguely of Twolegs.

title: Down With the Ship
description: A couple Twolegs are riding in their water monsters when suddenly you hear a crash and it starts to sink under the water. Maybe it got sick? You're not sure, but the Twolegs are now swimming to shore.

title: Strange Treasures
description: You find a small, squishy, brightly colored ball. It smells of Twolegs, but something about it makes you want to bat it around.

title: Catnip Patch
description: You find a lush patch of intoxicating plants. You have an overwhelming desire to roll in them. You can feel your stress melting away. Wait, what were you doing again?

title: Mayday
description: A sparrow flies right into the clear ice on the side of twoleg den and falls.

title: Natural Treasures
description: You find a brightly colored shell that almost gleams in the sunlight, with an intricate swirl pattern.

title: Natural Treasures
description: You find a bright, fluffy feather lazily blowing around in the breeze.

title: Inspiring Skies
description: You look up at the sky and see a cloud that resembles a cat. It reminds you of a loved one, making you feel watched over and cared for.

title: Mother Goose
description: These parents aren't happy about how close you are to their nest/hatchlings. They act hostile. Do you leave or try to get a meal?

title: Spooked
description: While sitting vigil, you hear the cracking of foliage. It's getting louder, closer, faster. Just when its about to reach you it suddenly stops. You don't hear it again.

title: Jumped
description: Its quiet, too quiet. You feel relaxed, that is until something jumps on your back! After reacting, you notice a frog jumping away in a hurry.

title: Butterfly Swarm
description: A traveling group of butterflies swarms around you. They flutter around for a while before continuing on their way.

title: Touched by a Firefly
description: A glowing firefly lands gently on your shoulder before drifting back into the night. It feels oddly magical.

title: StarClan's Blessing
description: A shooting star streaks across the sky, and an unexpected sense of peace washes over you. Perhaps your ancestors are watching.

title: Gentle Silence
description: The moon bathes the camp in silver light, and for several peaceful moments, nothing stirs except the leaves overhead. The silence is strangely comforting as you reflect on your new title.

title: A Gift in the Night
description: A feather drifts into camp, carried by the breeze. It lands neatly between your paws with a soft tickle.

title: Rustling Bushes
description: Something moves just beyond the camp entrance. After several tense heartbeats, a mouse scurries harmlessly away into the darkness.

title: The Longest Night
description: The hours seem to crawl by. The excitement of your ceremony has faded, leaving only the challenge of staying alert until dawn. When was the last time that you were awake this long?

title: A Passing Owl
description: The silent shape of an owl glides over camp without stopping, disappearing into the forest beyond. You watch until it vanishes into the darkness. Hopefully it doesn't return.

title: Heavy Eyelids
description: The day's excitement catches up with you. Your eyes grow heavy, and it's becoming difficult to stay awake. Think of something to keep yourself from falling asleep!

title: Tail Twitch
description: Your tail flicks against a pebble, sending it skittering across camp. Thankfully no one seems to wake up - that you can tell.

title: Things That Go Bump in the Night
description:
A loud crack echoes from beyond the camp walls. Your fur bristles as every possible explanation races through your mind.
Roll an 11 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to determine whether it's harmless or worth leaving your post.

title: Flickering Shadows
description:
Clouds drift across the moon, making the shadows around camp shift and dance. For a heartbeat, every stump and bush seems alive. It would be easy for a potential threat to sneak up on you.
Roll a 9 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to avoid startling yourself.

title: Buzzing Mosquitoes
description:
Mosquitoes seem determined to make your vigil miserable. One lands right on your ear, followed by another on your nose.
Roll a 7 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to quietly ignore the irritation.

title: Distant Predator
description:
A fox barks somewhere beyond the camp, but you can't tell if it's in the territory. Though it's far away, the sound sends a chill down your spine.
Roll an 11 or higher with `!roll 1d20` to determine whether it's harmless or worth leaving your post.
